description: Spatiotemporal Assessment of Solar Powered EV Charging Infrastructure: A Case Study of Kampala-Wakiso Area in Uganda is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset contains the input data and simulation outputs used in the study “Spatiotemporal Assessment of Solar Powered EV Charging Infrastructure: A Case Study of Kampala-Wakiso Area in Uganda.” The dataset supports the spatial, temporal, mobility, electric vehicle charging demand, and solar photovoltaic analyses undertaken for the Kampala-Wakiso study area. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Electric vehicles, solar photovoltaic (PV) integration, spatiotemporal analysis, energy demand modelling. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
